engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for subscribing to the error status of direction lights (right front and left rear turn signals) across different controllers/modules. It specifies the parameter names, instance IDs, and possible error status values for testing and validating the correct reporting of direction light errors in the vehicle's electronic system.
